Sleep-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Sleep marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Sleep workflows — not a literal paste of US marketing:

睡眠 vs 睡眠日程 vs 睡眠阶段

US pages use "Sleep", "Sleep Schedule", or "Sleep stages." China storefront copy often uses 睡眠 for the Sleep app ecosystem, 睡眠日程 when gallery frames show bedtime-and-wake schedule cards, and 睡眠阶段 when hypnogram or stage-breakdown charts dominate. AppLocale aligns phrasing with each screenshot frame — not one blanket term for every overlay.

Sleep Focus vs general Focus or Do Not Disturb

Sleep Focus (睡眠专注) is the bedtime Focus profile tied to Sleep Schedule — not Work Focus, not Personal Focus, and not generic Do Not Disturb unless that is what the screenshot depicts. When your gallery shows the Sleep Focus toggle during Wind Down, caption lines use 睡眠专注 — not 勿扰模式 alone unless the frame shows system DND UI.

Wind Down vs meditation or Background Sounds

Wind Down (睡前放松) is Apple's pre-bed routine surface — shortcut suggestions and dimmed UI before Sleep Focus — not a standalone meditation library and not Background Sounds ambient audio unless that is what the frame shows.

Sleep stages vs sleep-in-Health tiles

If your English listing leads with dedicated sleep stage charts and hypnogram UI, zh-Hans copy may emphasize 睡眠阶段 or 睡眠分析. If your gallery shows a generic Health app summary where sleep is one tile among vitals, that is Health-hub scope on the Apple Health guide — not this page unless Sleep is still your lead frame.

Bedtime alarms vs general Clock app marketing

Sleep-linked bedtime and wake alarms (就寝闹钟 / 起床闹钟) differ from generic alarm-clock app marketing. Match what buyers will see after enabling Sleep Schedule — gentle wake haptics on Apple Watch vs a standard Clock alarm UI.
